notes: Three «ح» branches end at أبو المغيرة, أبي (the father of عباس, not named here) and عمر; the names written once after the last «ح» (عن الأوزاعي ...) are read as the shared tail.
«قال أنبئت أن سعيد ...» has an unnamed informant («أنبئت» is passive): implicit transmission, so it needs a ruling (rule 11).
«- يعني ابن عبد الواحد -» and «- المعنى -» are editor glosses, left out.
